reason: The README describes an evidence-first deep research workspace for planning investigations, coordinating Web and subagent capabilities, tracking source-backed evidence, and saving research reports.

summaries.zh: 一个以证据为先的深度研究工作区，用于规划调查、协调网页与子智能体能力、跟踪来源证据并保存研究报告。
summaries.en: An evidence-first deep research workspace for planning investigations, coordinating Web and subagent capabilities, tracking source-backed evidence, and saving research reports.

capabilities: Creates and persists research projects and plans
Uses available Web and subagent capabilities to conduct investigations
Stores source-linked evidence, coverage status, limitations, and reports
Provides a Web workspace to search, filter, sort, resume, stop, or delete projects
